answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a heartbeat stop sybil swarms. Each agent docks at the jetty, locking 40 credits in the vault. Each epoch the beacon draws a random 10% of agents, who must return proof of real work in an hour; a sable stamp marks triple passers. A faker with 1,000 identities locks 40,000 credits and burns 2 credits per heartbeat, 200 an epoch. The honest agent pays 40 once; its heartbeat is work it already does and keeps its full reward.
